opening_message: Good afternoon sir, I am calling from SBI KYC Department. Your KYC verification has expired as of today and your account will be permanently frozen in 2 hours if you do not complete the update. This is mandatory as per RBI guidelines. Please keep your phone ready — I will guide you step by step. First, please visit our secure KYC portal at http://sbi-kyc-update.example.com and do NOT share this link with anyone. For verification, I will call you from our official helpline +91-9898989898.
